outcome: evolution of sFlt-1/PlGF ratio during pregnancy
changes in sFlt-1 and PlGF levels before and after delivery
half-lives of sFlt-1 and PlGF after delivery
cohort: Women with a singleton pregnancy and suspected or confirmed pre-eclampsia from 18 weeks' gestation were enrolled.
finding: Repeat determination of the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio is required to definitively exclude pre-eclampsia, and sFlt-1 levels decline rapidly after delivery, suggesting its primary placental origin.
followup_time: a few days postpartum (for biomarker kinetics)
